tournament.name: August OCC - Qualifier A
tournament.description: OCC AUGUST SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - August 13th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline August 13th @ 1200 GMT) - (participation confirmation deadline August 12th) - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season. (Round of 8 Finals - August 20th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline August 18th @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
